positions.clause: Each scheme signs every required signer's exact Core signing_message with the high-level k256 Signer::try_sign; signing the digest with Signer (double hash) and sign_prehash on the full message (missing outer hash) are refused, and no auxiliary randomness is guessed (Schnorr zero auxiliary bytes, ECDSA deterministic RFC6979).
positions.evidence: intent.rs verify_intent uses Verifier::verify(message); intent.ak SigCheckV2.digest is sha2_256(message) and verify dispatches to the Cardano Schnorr/ECDSA builtins on that digest; R1 signing-route reasoning is retained unchanged.

positions.clause: Because thread.required_signers demands the escrow debit signer and the seller invoice-discharge creditor for the full gold partial shape, each helper call creates exactly two fresh ephemeral keys (escrow first, seller second), each from exactly one 32-byte /dev/urandom read with the scheme validated before any entropy is opened and with no retry or redraw on an invalid scalar; secret material is never stored, printed or serialized, existing wallets and keys are never read, and neither test key is a future live catalogue key.
positions.evidence: thread.ak required_signers maps Transfer/Fee from-accounts and discharge creditors to required signers; gold invoice/partial ordered effects are Fee escrow->fees 2, Transfer escrow->seller 35, Discharge invoice, State paid. A single-signature design can only pass VI by narrowing the shape, which R2 refuses. Helper source: scheme match before file/entropy access, two sequential read_exact draws, static errors, panic=abort, best-effort buffer zeroing with no erasure theorem claimed.
